PPO is not the right tool for doing RL in RLHF. We break apart PPO and show that the most “basic” policy gradient algorithm, Vanilla Policy Gradient REINFORCE (Sutton & Barto, 2020), is consistently outperforming PPO by 3.2% to 20.3% interms of win-rate, across all dataset and base model pairing .
